title: eriogonum calcareum
intro: Eriogonum calcareum, commonly known as Calcareous Buckwheat or Calcareous Sulphur Buckwheat, is a flowering plant species belonging to the buckwheat family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum calcareum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
